customers.evidence: we never lose sight of our main mission: serving our clients.

employees.evidence: Teams succeed because they are disciplined, they work well together, they execute consistently and they have a passion to win.

community.evidence: always be there for our clients and communities

shareholders.evidence: They focus on how we strengthen, safeguard and grow our company over time.

integrity.evidence: Maintaining the highest standards of integrity involves faithfully meeting our commitments to all our constituents

result.analyst_notes: Firm, first-person plural voice with a hedged opening: we cannot promise specific outcomes, then a firm what we can and will promise. Headings present values as named pillars. Customers and integrity lead; employees and community appear in shorter passages. Wording is aspirational, such as fierce resolve and best and most respected bank, with few concrete commitments.
